answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 250 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the meadow challenge, the walnut audit can replay the plume history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2657 identities would post 1613 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
